'''R5-2JE''', also known as "'''Toojay'''," was an [[R5 series astromech droid]] that served as the head of the [[droid]] pool for the [[forest]] landing area in the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. The droid also filled out shipboard astromech duties, and used a [[restraining bolt]] that had been modified into a [[command signal bolt]] that allowed R5-2JE to send commands and work orders to similarly equipped [[Resistance]] droids from a distance.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> R5-2JE was among those in the base who celebrated the Resistance's [[Battle of Exegol|victory]] in the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. The droid stood by the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', a [[YT-1300 light freighter]], when Resistance members [[Chewbacca]] and [[Rose Tico]] embraced each other during the festivities.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> As an [[R-series]] unit<ref name="TROS VD" /> R5-2JE was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]. It stood 97 [[centimeter]]s tall<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and had [[Color|red]] and white plating and silver [[photoreceptor]]s. The droid was also equipped with spacecraft linkage and control [[Limb|arms]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-2JE was created for the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> which was released on [[December 20]], [[2019]].<ref name="Jedi Redeemed">{{InsiderCite|196|The Jedi Redeemed: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker|The Jedi Redeemed: ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker''}}</ref> The droid was revealed prior to the film's release in a [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] pack of figures tied into the film and released by [[The Walt Disney Company]]<ref name="Toy">{{DisneyToyCite|set=Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=D-O · R5-2JE · R6-LE5 · R2-SHP|link=star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-droid-factory-figure-set-400911413423.html}}</ref> in [[November]], 2019.<ref name="ToyDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=3855|text=D-O/R5-2JE/R6-LE5/R2-SHP - Droid Factory|author=Harrison, Paul|date=2019-12-12|archivedate=20210116080954}}</ref> The droid was then identified as "Toojay" in ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="TROS VD" />
